lines: Then, great offerings were arranged
於是，盛大的供品都準備擺設好了
And the king arrived above the mandala.
國王登上了壇城
Holding flowers, he joined his palms,
他手拿著花，雙手合十
And pronounced these words of truth:
說出了這段真實語：
“Greatest of beings, powerful Muni, son of the Shakyas,
一切眾生中最尊貴的、大威力的釋迦牟尼佛，
With countless emanations you benefit samsara's wanderers,
您化現無數身形，利益著在輪迴中漂泊的眾生，
Oh Teacher, Sugata, and all the buddhas of the ten directions
導師、善逝，以及十方一切諸佛，
Please bestow happiness and excellence!
請賜給我們安樂與吉祥！
The river flow of your skillful means and noble compassion
您善巧方便與慈悲的力量，像河流一樣不間斷，
Tames different disciples with whatever means are best suited to them,
用最適合每個人的方法，調伏各種不同的弟子，
And ripens and liberates them all—
讓大家都能成熟、得到解脫——
Mighty Lord Chenrezik and all the bodhisattvas
大力的觀世音菩薩，以及所有的菩薩們，
Please bestow happiness and excellence!
請賜給我們安樂與吉祥！
Through the four ways of magnetizing disciples,
您用四種攝受的方法，攝受著弟子，
You spread the genuine Dharma—the Victor's pure and flawless speech
弘揚真正的佛法——那是佛陀清淨無瑕的教導，
Neten Rabjor and all the sons and daughters of the victorious ones,
尊者須菩提，以及一切佛陀的弟子們，
Please bestow happiness and excellence!
請賜給我們安樂與吉祥！
And further, all the buddhas and bodhisattvas
此外，一切諸佛菩薩，
Of the past, present, and future
不論過去、現在、未來，
In all the pure realms of the ten directions
在十方所有清淨的淨土之中，
Please, in this place, bestow empowerment and blessing!”
請在這裡，賜給我們灌頂與加持！」
In this way the nirmanakaya king brought auspiciousness
就這樣，化身王帶來了吉祥，
Through the power of his words of truth, and at that time,
靠著真實語的力量，就在那個時候，
All the victors and their heirs, the yidams, and Dharmapalas,
一切的佛、菩薩、本尊和護法，
Came in a flurry like the particles of dust in rays of sunlight,
就像陽光下飛舞的塵粒一樣，紛紛湧現，
And gathered together like thick clouds and fog,
又像濃密的雲霧一樣聚集在一起，
All the buddhas threw flowers down from the sky, and through this blessing,
諸佛從天上灑下花朵，透過這份加持，
Their sons and daughters sang verses of auspiciousness.
佛的弟子們唱起了吉祥的偈頌。
Brahma and the other gods sent down a rain of flowers,
梵天和其他天神們降下了花雨，
The goddesses made perfect offerings,
天女們獻上了圓滿的供養，
The sky resounded with the dakinis' divine music,
天空中迴盪著空行母美妙的音樂，
And the sweet scent of incense was everywhere.
甜美的薰香瀰漫在每個角落。
The gathering of jnanasattvas, pervading all of space,
遍滿虛空的智慧尊眾，
Merged into the samayasattvas, and the two became forever united.
融入了誓言尊之中，兩者從此合而為一。
In beautiful melodies, the gods sang many praises of the Dharma-raja,
天神們用美妙的旋律，唱誦著讚頌法王的歌，
And in this way, the two supreme shrine halls were spontaneously consecrated.
就這樣，兩座殊勝的殿堂自然而然完成了開光。
Everyone witnessed these miracles, like reflections in a mirror,
大家都親眼見證了這些奇蹟，就像鏡子裡的影像一樣，
And for many months and years thereafter,
之後好幾個月、好幾年，
The Tibetans sang, danced, and held festivals
藏地的人們唱歌、跳舞、舉行慶典，
Recounting what had transpired.
一直傳講著當時發生的事。
The king sang this song of joy:
國王唱起了這首歡喜的歌：
“Embodiments of noble compassion, o three that are so rare and supreme,
大悲的化現、稀有而殊勝的三寶，
And teacher of the path to liberation, Chenrezik,
還有指引解脫道路的觀世音菩薩，
With my mind filled with respect, I supplicate you.
我以恭敬的心，向您祈請。
Today, above, in the sky so vast
今天，在那廣大的天空中，
We saw the buddhas and bodhisattvas gather like clouds,
我們親眼看見諸佛菩薩像雲一樣聚集，
Bringing auspiciousness and consecration spontaneously.
自然而然地帶來了吉祥與開光加持。
Brahma and all the other celestial deities
梵天和所有天界的神明們，
Let loose the sound of music from their cymbals
敲響了他們的鈸，奏出美妙的音樂，
And sent down a rain of mandha flowers,
並且降下了曼陀羅花雨，
Bringing auspiciousness and consecration spontaneously.
自然而然地帶來了吉祥與開光加持。
The victory banner of the Buddha's teachings was planted,
佛陀教法的勝利旗幟豎立起來了，
And in all directions, negativity was vanquished by the Dharma.
佛法在四面八方擊敗了一切的惡，
Its glorious power defeated Mara's armies,
用它光榮的力量，打敗了魔的軍隊，
Bringing auspiciousness and consecration spontaneously.
自然而然地帶來了吉祥與開光加持。
By beating the great drum of genuine Dharma,
敲響了真正佛法的大鼓，
The five poisons and ignorance that is their source dissolved in their own place.
五毒和它們的根源——無明，當下就自己消融了。
The three rare and supreme ones' drum resounded,
稀有殊勝的三寶，法鼓響徹了四方，
Bringing auspiciousness and consecration spontaneously.
自然而然地帶來了吉祥與開光加持。
Today, the sun of happiness has shined,
今天，快樂的太陽升起了，
And uncontrollable joy is born in my mind.
我心中生起了難以抑制的喜悅。
All that we need falls to us like rain,
我們所需要的一切，都像雨一樣降臨，
Auspiciousness and consecration are spontaneously present.
吉祥與開光加持，本自現前。
The yidam deities' auspiciousness
本尊聖眾的吉祥，
Brings auspiciousness to Song-tsen Gampo,
為松贊干布帶來了吉祥，
And he sings this auspicious song.
於是他唱起了這首吉祥的歌。
May my Tibetan subjects enjoy auspiciousness!”
願我的藏地子民都享有吉祥！」
This song of delight he sang in a voice as beautiful as Brahma's
他用像梵天一樣美妙的聲音，唱出了這首歡喜的歌，
And the gods, people, and all beings rejoiced.
天神、人們，以及一切眾生，都感到歡喜。
